training.title: GRAK'S RECRUITS
training.safe: Take your time. The defense resumes when you place someone.
training.starting_gold: Gunners cost 50 gold each. You have enough for two.
training.funding: +{gold} gold to pay for this recruit.
training.plan: Place a defender to resume. Waves follow automatically; p pauses, n sends the next early.
training.locked: This defender joins later. Build with the recruits you have.
training.gunner: I'll put two Gunners near the entrance, covering the same road. They fire quickly, one fighter at a time. Move with arrows or WASD, choose a Gunner with 1, then Enter or click to place.
training.frost: Put her where the Gunners can follow up. Frost slows fighters and stops Rogues evading their shots. She joins before the first Rogues arrive.
training.cannon: The crew's blast catches several fighters at once. Put them where frost holds a crowd. Blasts deal full damage through Paladin plate and Rogue evasion.
training.ranger: Give her a long view of the road. Arrows deal full damage through Centurion wards. Select her and press t to change targets; strongest picks the fighter with the most health.
training.slingers: Keep them close to the road; their slings don't reach far. They're cheap and fire quickly. Frost helps them hit Rogues, but their stones do little against Paladin plate.
training.lightning: His lightning jumps between nearby fighters. Give him a crowded stretch to cover. Keep guns or arrows nearby for Centurions; their wards cut lightning damage by 80%.
training.trebuchet: The crew throws slowly, with a wide blast and long reach. Cover bends or stretches the road comes back past. Frost gives them time to land a shot. Blasts bypass plate and evasion.
training.runeforge: All seven main defenders are available. Add the Runeforge's beam along a straight road; it burns every fighter in its path. Use [ ] for specialists, 1 to choose it, r to turn it. Frost keeps fighters in the beam. One per level.
training.hookmaster: Put him beside your best firing stretch. He drags fighters back through it. Heavy fighters move less; champions barely move. Fighters recover between pulls and eventually resist them altogether. One per level.
training.sappers: Put the crew near the road to plant mines, including between waves. Blasts bypass plate and evasion. Recruits can use up the charges before heavier fighters arrive. Selling the crew removes its mines. One per level.
training.witch: She marks fighters so your other defenders deal more damage. Put her within reach of their targets. She starts on strongest targeting, deals no damage herself, and marks don't stack. One per level. Waves follow automatically; p pauses.
training.next_defense: Hold the Rotunda first. Specialists join during the next guided defense.
training.after_wave: Joins after wave {wave}. Once recruited, stays available on retries.

help_guide.goal: Hold all twenty waves. Each fighter through the exit takes one heart; a champion takes six. Gold buys defenders and upgrades. Kills and cleared waves earn more.
help_guide.opening: Choose Start for the campaign. Put two Gunners near the entrance, covering the same road. Add frost where they can follow up. Look for bends and returning lanes; one good position can cover several passes.
help_guide.modes: The campaign introduces recruits, opens floors and fills the journal. Quick Play offers the full roster and saves scores, without changing campaign progress. Recruitment pauses the action and pays for the new defender.
help_guide.saves: Completed defenses, recruits, discoveries and scores save automatically. An unfinished defense starts over when you return. Save failures stay visible; Ctrl+L retries. Fix the reported problem before quitting.
help_guide.placement_tip: Choose a defender again for each placement. Green dots are legal sites. Walls block building, but attacks pass over them.
help_guide.manage_tip: First targets the fighter furthest along the road. Strongest uses current health; closest uses distance. The dotted guide shows the selected target.
help_guide.pace_tip: Waves follow automatically. Pause before spending if you need time. Sending a wave early earns bonus gold.
help_guide.other_tip: Help pauses a defense. Escape cancels placement or selection; after a finished defense it returns to the lair or Quick Play.
help_guide.rogue: Guns, arrows and slings deal half damage while the Rogue is unfrosted. Frost disables evasion while the slow lasts. Blasts, lightning and the Runeforge beam bypass it.
help_guide.paladin: Plate cuts gun and sling damage by 75%, arrows by 40%. Use Cannoniers, Trebuchets, mines or magic for full damage. Slow him where those defenders can keep firing.
help_guide.centurion: The ward cuts frost, lightning and Runeforge damage by 80%. Guns, arrows, slings and blasts deal full damage. Frost still slows him.
help_guide.others: A killed Necromancer leaves two Squires, each with half his health. Keep fire on that spot. Champions cost six hearts on a breach; keep damage on the final approach.
help_guide.forge: Rotate with r while placing or after selecting. The beam burns every fighter along its line. Aim down a straight road; frost holds fighters in the beam. Centurion wards resist it.
help_guide.ogre: Put him beside a strong firing stretch. He pulls fighters backward through it. Heavy fighters move less; champions barely move. Recovery and a total pull limit prevent trapping one fighter forever.
help_guide.sapper: The crew plants mines nearby, even between waves. Blasts bypass plate and evasion. Recruits may use the stock before heavier fighters arrive. Selling the crew removes its mines.
help_guide.witch: She marks one fighter to take more damage from other defenders. She deals no damage herself. Strongest targeting helps focus on champions. Marks do not stack or remove plate and wards.
help_guide.limit: One of each specialist per defense. Selling frees its slot.
help_guide.route: Rotunda > Rift > Long Halls > Sunken Garden. Hold all four on the same renown to open the Heart. Hold the Heart too to enter the Depths. Tab changes renown; floor victories are tracked separately.
help_guide.relic: Clean waves earn relics. At the Rotunda, t spends one on gold, a free Gunner or extra health for the next defense. Gold and health bonuses stack; one free Gunner may be reserved. Campaign discoveries fill the journal.
help_guide.seed: Type digits on the Depths to set a repeatable route. Backspace deletes a digit; c clears the seed. An empty seed or zero generates a random route.
help_guide.replay: At the Rotunda, i replays the opening; e replays an earned ending. Replays grant no rewards. Reset progress in the main menu clears campaign progress, relics, journal and scores after confirmation.
